summary: Chiron and Black Moon Lilith are modern secondary points that may appear in the same chart only when the user enables them.
body: Use Chiron and Black Moon Lilith as optional modern shadow-and-healing points. They can be displayed inside the same chart wheel and chart interpretation flow, but they are hidden by default behind a user-controlled toggle. They do not replace planets, rulers, dignity, sect, houses, or time-lord logic.
definition: Display and weighting policy for modern secondary points such as Chiron and Black Moon Lilith.
appUsage: Default chart view: hide modern points unless the user turns on the modern-points toggle.
When enabled, show Chiron and Black Moon Lilith in the same chart display with a visual distinction from planets.
Label the toggle clearly, for example: Chiron & Lilith, Shadow Points, or Modern Points.
Do not show these points as chart rulers, sign rulers, sect factors, dignity factors, or time-lord candidates.
If a modern point closely contacts the Sun, Moon, Ascendant, Venus, Mars, or Midheaven, allow an optional callout in the reading.

surfacePolicy.default: Hidden by default in the main chart.
surfacePolicy.toggle: User can enable Chiron and Black Moon Lilith in the same chart view.
surfacePolicy.label: The UI must make clear that these are modern secondary points, not planets or traditional rulers.
surfacePolicy.readingPlacement: When enabled, they may appear in a Shadow & Healing, Reclamation, or Modern Points section, or as optional callouts inside the main chart reading.
surfacePolicy.visualTreatment: Use a distinct glyph, color, opacity, or layer treatment so users can tell these points apart from planets.

prohibitions: Do not show modern points by default without an opt-in.
Do not use modern points as chart rulers or sign rulers.
Do not include modern points in dignity, sect, profection, zodiacal releasing, or traditional timing calculations.
Do not let a modern point override a clear planet, house, ruler, or angle indication.
Do not frame Chiron or Lilith placements as fate, pathology, or permanent damage.
weighting: Use as secondary interpretive material after planets, angles, houses, rulers, and major aspects.
Weight up when Chiron or Black Moon Lilith is conjunct or tightly aspecting the Sun, Moon, Ascendant, Venus, Mars, or Midheaven.
Weight up when the point is angular or closely tied to a chart concentration.
For daily content, avoid overemphasizing slow modern point movement unless a personal contact, station, return, or house ingress is relevant.

orbs.generalAspect: Prefer 1-2 degrees unless the app's aspect engine has a stricter policy.
